digest.component_or_area: bridge projects store and CLI/library/MCP surface
propositions: The bridge must record which tracker projects a store syncs and which repos each project owns, stored in .bridge_state/projects.json at the store level rather than per-repo to prevent diff conflicts across shared snapshots

resolve_project() implements a tri-state rule: returns legacy_default for absent ticket fields, None for explicit empty string, the project key for set values, and None when legacy_default itself is empty
bridge projects CLI verbs (list/set/remove) and their library and MCP counterparts must operate on the same .bridge_state/projects.json record with byte-identical results across all three surfaces
set requires --repos argument (error if omitted) and replaces rather than merges the repos list; set --repos "" stores an empty list [] explicitly
An absent .bridge_state/projects.json record is legal and reads as empty mapping with None legacy_default (fail-safe until seeded), while a malformed record raises an error
The bridge group help file and argparse metavar must both list projects as a verb, and mapping writes must not mutate bindings.json or prev_snapshot.json
